Ask: Generate all 15 Blogger v3 schema structs into `gen/schemas/models.go` - wanted: one compiling Go file with faithful, SDK-compatible models. For you: `gen/schemas/models.go` is written and verified - it defines all 15 schemas (plus the 20 nested object schemas they reference), mirrored field-for-field after the canonical `google.golang.org/api/blogger/v3` types at the pinned v0.299.0, with correct json tags, `omitempty`, and per-field `// Optional.` annotations (the live discovery doc, revision 20260924, declares no required properties). Now: none. Next: none.

## What was built

`gen/schemas/models.go` (492 lines, `package schemas`): 35 structs, 148 fields.

- **15 top-level schemas**: Blog, BlogList, BlogPerUserInfo, BlogUserInfo, Comment, CommentList, Page, PageList, Pageviews, Post, PostList, PostPerUserInfo, PostUserInfo, PostUserInfosList, User
- **20 nested schemas** the above reference (BlogLocale, BlogPages, BlogPosts, CommentAuthor/-Image/-Blog/-InReplyTo/-Post, PageAuthor/-Image/-Blog, PageviewsCounts, PostAuthor/-Image/-Blog/-Images/-Location/-Replies, UserBlogs, UserLocale), keeping the exact published Go field names (e.g. `TitleLink`, `BlogId`, `blog_user_info`, `post_user_info`, `PageviewsCounts.Count` and `PostReplies.TotalItems` with `json:",string"`)
- Every field has a json tag with `omitempty` and a `// Optional.` doc comment with the published description and enum value lists. Package doc records provenance: discovery revision 20260924, mirrors canonical v0.299.0.
- Single-file, zero imports, zero methods. The canonical types' SDK plumbing (`ForceSendFields`, `NullFields`, embedded `googleapi.ServerResponse`, gensupport marshal helpers) is intentionally omitted and this is documented in the package doc - that machinery can't be replicated outside google.golang.org/api (internal package), and eng/builder marshals via stdlib `encoding/json`. Per the spec's "define standalone types" branch, models keep exact field names/types/tags so JSON produced is identical to the canonical package.

## Verification (all on the frozen file)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `go build ./gen/schemas/...` (required VERIFY) | exit 0 |
| `gofmt -l gen/schemas/` | clean (empty) |
| `go vet ./gen/schemas/...` | exit 0 |
| Field parity vs canonical v0.299.0 (names/types/tags, all 35 types) | exact, 0 mismatches |
| Cross-version stability v0.250.0 vs v0.299.0 | identical - names won't drift |
| Live discovery revision 20260924 cross-check (every json name + type family) | 0 problems |
| JSON round-trip smoke test (throwaway module in /tmp, 30 checks: nested types, `blog_user_info`, string-encoded int64s, omitempty→`{}`, enums) | all passed |

Note: verification artifacts live in `/tmp` (`/tmp/bg-smoke`, `/tmp/check_models.py`) - the repo contains only the in-scope `gen/schemas/models.go` addition (plus siblings' files from other nodes).
